set_requires_grad: freeze or unfreeze PyTorch network parameters by setting requires_grad on all modules in a list
extract_bbox_patch: extract image patches from torch or numpy arrays using bounding box coordinates in top-left-height-width format
scale_bbox: enlarge bounding boxes to a target size while keeping the original box centered within the new box
extract_around_bbox: extract scaled image patches around bounding boxes by combining bbox scaling and patch extraction in one call
review_model_utils: review the model_utils module containing PyTorch and numpy helper functions for bounding box and network parameter manipulation
